map.管理地毯吸尘、深度清洗、晾干养护周期。根据地毯类型和使用强度推荐养护频率，追踪各: Manage carpet vacuuming, deep washing and drying cycles. Recommend care frequency by carpet type and usage intensity, track each maintenance due date, with a common-stain treatment guide.

map.养护频率根据地毯类型和使用强度自动计算，实际可结合环境灰尘量调整: Care frequency is auto-computed by carpet type and usage intensity; adjust by ambient dust in practice
map.羊毛和丝质地毯忌高温水洗和暴晒，建议专业干洗或低温局部清洁: Wool and silk carpets avoid high-temperature washing and sun exposure; prefer professional dry cleaning or low-temperature spot cleaning
map.深度清洗后需充分晾干，潮湿地毯易滋生霉菌和异味: After deep washing, dry thoroughly; damp carpets easily breed mould and odour
map.处理污渍时应先用干布吸干液体，再从污渍外缘向中心擦拭，避免扩大: When treating a stain, first blot liquid with a dry cloth, then wipe from the stain edge toward the centre to avoid spreading
map.点击「✅」可快速记录当日维护，自动更新下次到期时间: Tap ✅ to quickly log today's maintenance and auto-update the next due date
map.家庭地毯日常养护，按人流设定吸尘频率，防止砂粒磨损绒面。: For home carpet daily care, set vacuum frequency by foot traffic to prevent sand from wearing the pile.
map.酒店客房地毯计划性清洗，平衡住客体验与晾干空房成本。: Planned washing of hotel-room carpets balances guest experience with the cost of vacant rooms during drying.
map.养宠家庭针对毛屑与尿渍设定更高频的局部清理节奏。: Pet-owning households set a higher-frequency local-cleaning rhythm for fur and urine stains.
map.日常吸尘每周 2 次，饮料泼洒等局部污渍即时处理，深度清洗每 3-6 个月一次；: Daily vacuum twice a week, treat local stains like spills immediately, deep wash every 3-6 months; after washing, ventilate and dry about 24 hours before walking on it.
map.深度清洗后多久能干透？: How long to fully dry after deep washing?
map.通风良好约 24-48 小时，潮湿季节或厚绒地毯更久；未干透前走动会留水印并易霉: Well-ventilated about 24-48 hours, longer in humid seasons or thick-pile carpets; walking before fully dry leaves water marks and risks mould.
map.整块地毯能机洗吗？: Can a whole carpet be machine-washed?
map.小块可机洗垫，大面积满铺地毯建议专业设备抽洗，机洗易缩水变形且难彻底脱水。: Small washable mats can go in a machine; large wall-to-wall carpets should be professionally extracted - machine washing easily shrinks, deforms and fails to fully dewater.
map.宠物尿渍怎么处理？: How to treat pet urine stains?
map.先用纸吸干、再用酶类清洁剂分解蛋白除味，避免用氨水（气味类似尿会诱导再次乱尿），: First blot with paper, then use an enzyme cleaner to break down protein and remove odour; avoid ammonia (smells like urine and may trigger re-marking), then dry thoroughly.
